text: Nope, not doing that. Like I said, I don't remember my email. And I don't remember my email address. That's not going to work. This is wasting my time. I need this fixed today. Can I just talk to someone who can actually fix this?
zh: 不行，我不做那件事。就像我说的，我记不住我的电子邮件。我记不住我的电子邮件地址。那行不通。这是在浪费我的时间。我今天需要解决这个问题。我能和能实际解决这个问题的人谈谈吗？
